verdict.rationale: Jules is fundamentally a delegate-tasks-to-an-agent product: users assign coding tasks via GitHub labels, web app, or API, Jules plans, executes in a VM, and returns diffs/PRs for approval — this is corroborated by extensive first-party docs and numerous community users confirming real task delegation and PR generation (jules-docs-2/3/4/7/8, jules-comm-2/6/11/12/16). Missing for 10: independent quality benchmarks and resolution of community complaints about reliability/loops that temper confidence in consistent execution.
